answer: The desk takes a waiting period of 3 days that no payment can shorten per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. One name, one proof, one entry: Silvered physician mallet warrant enforces it, and a warrant physicians hold after pulse checks is how the check runs. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. One quill, one entry. The clerk notes delta. The tally keeps willow.
